Geppetto is Rogue Fairy Studios' fork of Krita.

Krita itself is part of the KDE community and is developed on
KDE's infrastructure, not GitHub's:

https://invent.kde.org/graphics/krita

Changes that are useful to Krita as a whole should be proposed
there. Changes specific to Geppetto can be proposed as pull
requests on this repository.

Please see the HACKING file for coding guidelines, which Geppetto
inherits from Krita. The Krita API documentation is here:

https://api.kde.org/legacy/krita/html/index.html
